messages: I hear that #p203# in #m10001000# is worried about something...

I ran into #p203# in #m10001000#, who seemed overcome with worry. She told me that they were short on decorations for the village festival and asked me to get #b10 #t4000007#s#k and #b20 #t4000010#s#k.
